explanation: This is the second half of Arathoon–Ball–Kvalheim Theorem 1: after perturbing the charges, there are 5 positive charges whose potential has finitely many critical points, all non-degenerate, and at least 24 of them. Critical points off the charge locations are computed via the gradient of Σq_j/‖x − a_j‖, and non-degeneracy via the second derivative. The statement is correct and solved.
